title: CreteXtract control layer: companion repository for the Prototypes for Humanity 2026 short paper
description: Schema (16 columns), extraction prompt v1.4, validation prompt v1.4 and the executable validation rule set that constitute the control layer of CreteXtract, a web application that runs commercially available large language models inside a controlled extraction workflow to convert published chloride-diffusion evidence on concrete into traceable datasets. These are the artefacts of the configuration evaluated in the short paper CreteXtract: From Literature to Auditable Chloride-Diffusion Evidence for Low-Carbon Concrete (Flah and Nehdi, Prototypes for Humanity 2026, Dubai).
